title: Job editor Hosts tab freezes on large host imports — it uses the naive grid-fill paths the main grid was already optimized away from
existing_state: The job editor's per-job host grid fills row-by-row, cell-by-cell on the live grid. ApplyHostGridSnapshot (JobEditorDialog.cs:898-939) does Rows.Add() per row plus a string-keyed gridRow.Cells[columnName].Value assignment per cell, with no redraw suppression or bulk AddRange; it is the path behind Copy from Main Grid (JobEditorDialog.cs:1890-1908), Import CSV (1861-1888), and the initial PopulateHostGrid (794-801, called at 1611). Ctrl+V routes to HostGridUtilities.PasteClipboardText (JobEditorDialog.cs:1829-1836 -> Utilities/HostGridUtilities.cs:224-273), which grows the grid one Rows.Add(new DataGridViewRow()) at a time INSIDE the per-cell inner loop. The grid has RowPostPaint and CellPainting handlers wired (JobEditorDialog.cs:1394-1395), so every add invalidates and repaints. Form1's main grid had exactly this problem and was fixed: Form1.PasteFromClipboard (Form1.cs:9604-9693) documents the pathology in comments ('the grid services thousands of paint messages', 'O(rows^2) work') and implements WM_SETREDRAW suppression, handler detachment, and off-grid bulk row building — but that fix never reached the job editor's paths. Since Copy from Main Grid copies the entire main grid, a job targeting a few thousand hosts hits a multi-second UI freeze every time the Hosts tab is populated.
recommendation: Port Form1's optimized bulk-fill technique into HostGridUtilities as a single shared ApplyRowsBulk(grid, columns, rows) helper (WM_SETREDRAW off, build DataGridViewRow objects off-grid with values pre-set, one Rows.AddRange, restore redraw) and call it from JobEditorDialog.ApplyHostGridSnapshot and HostGridUtilities.PasteClipboardText. This is a contained change: both call sites already funnel through these two methods.
user_benefit: Copy-from-main-grid, CSV import, paste, and opening the editor for a large-fleet job become instant instead of freezing the dialog for seconds — the exact scenario this app is built for.

evidence.note: per-row/per-cell snapshot apply used by CSV import, Copy from Main Grid and initial load; paint handlers attached to the grid
PasteClipboardText adds rows one at a time inside the per-cell loop, no redraw suppression
main-grid paste already implements the fix (WM_SETREDRAW, off-grid bulk rows) with comments describing the exact pathology
